input: How many PTO days can I carry over to next year?
expected_output: At most 5 unused PTO days carry over; the rest is lost on 1 January.

input: How far in advance do I need to request a week off?
expected_output: Requests of 3 or more consecutive days must be submitted in Workday at least 2 weeks in advance.

input: When do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
expected_output: A doctor's note is needed for absences longer than 3 consecutive working days, uploaded in Workday.

input: Can I fly premium economy to a conference in Singapore? The flight is 13 hours.
expected_output: Yes. Premium economy is allowed on flights longer than 8 hours; book through TravelPerk.

input: What's the daily meal allowance when travelling for work, and is wine covered?
expected_output: Up to 50 EUR per day; alcohol is not reimbursed.

input: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication on GitHub?
expected_output: No. 2FA must use the Okta Verify app; SMS codes are not allowed.

input: I lost my laptop on the train at 23:00. What do I do?
expected_output: Report it to security@lumenlabs.example within 1 hour, even outside working hours.

input: What's the notice period if I resign during probation?
expected_output: 2 weeks during the 6-month probation period (1 month after probation).

input: I want to buy a 350 EUR online course. Do I need approval, and does it come out of my home office stipend?
expected_output: Yes, purchases over 300 EUR need manager approval first. It comes out of the 1,000 EUR yearly learning budget, not the home office stipend.

input: Is a new monitor for home paid separately or from the stipend, and how much is the stipend?
expected_output: It comes out of the one-time 400 EUR home office stipend, not a separate budget.

input: I joined 4 months ago and my partner is due to give birth. Do I get the full 12 weeks paid leave as the non-birthing parent?
expected_output: Not yet: full paid leave requires at least 6 months of employment; before that statutory rules apply. Non-birthing parents get 12 weeks once eligible.

input: When do salary changes take effect?
expected_output: Salary adjustments are decided in the March review cycle and take effect from 1 April.
